title: Stacks
objective: Use last in, first out to check that brackets are balanced.

sources.title: Cormen, Leiserson, Rivest and Stein, Introduction to Algorithms, 4th ed. (MIT Press, 2022): stacks

simplifies: Only ( ) and [ ] are checked. Adding { } is one more entry in pairs; the method is the same.

options.explanation: Counts match, but order matters: ) arrives while [ is still the most recent opener.
Right. When ) arrives, the top of the stack is [, so they do not match.
Balance is about order, not the language.

quiz.prompt: Which of these works like a stack (last in, first out)?

options.explanation: Right. The most recent change is undone first.
That is first in, first out: a queue.
That has no order at all.
